title: Linear hero
description: A quiet near-black hero: a big tight-tracked 64px headline in two lines at the left, a grey one-line subtitle with a small 'New · feature →' link at the far right of the same row, then a wide product-window slot on a lit stage that fades from page black to a cool grey at its rounded bottom edge. The headline, row and window fade in from a slight blur and rise on load, one after another.
notes: media: a product screenshot or video at ~1.83:1; empty, a bordered placeholder panel of that size
on phones the window is ~660px wide and cropped by the stage's right edge, as on the original
the stage light mixes the background into the muted-foreground grey: best on dark themes
